description: AlphaLocker is a low-cost ransomware operation built on the EDA2 open-source project that sells affiliates an admin panel, ransomware executable, and decryption key generator, lowering the barrier for entry-level cybercriminals using double-extortion tactics.

techniques.technique_details: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in public-facing applications and lack of software maintenance or patching as an entry vector.
Use of phishing emails to compromise the target system, typically containing malicious attachments or links.

techniques.technique_name: Automated Exfiltration; Exfiltration Over Web Service
techniques.technique_details: The group employs a double extortion tactic, exfiltrating data automatically and/or via web services before encryption, threatening to leak the data if ransom is not paid.
Core ransomware action where victim files are encrypted for extortion purposes.
